top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: In the 3 to 5 yr old classroom the room had inadequte light and the children were not visable. The caregiver could not see the children.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The center director has been unable to meet director responsibility requirements. Repeated deficiencies in the areas of background checks and fire safety have occurred.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon CCR's arrival the operation was using a reduced nap time ratio with only 1 caregiver present in the building and more than 13 children.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §746.1613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Specified Age Group for the children napping in a centralized location was 2 years old. There were 23 children with 1 caregiver in the group. The number of caregivers for this many children in that age group during naptime is 2.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training records were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child needs emergency care authorization to be redone due to water damage on form.
